headline: Overnight run-up: DEXY 106.8k -> 140.1k ADA (on-chain holders 78 -> 94) and SER 109.2k -> 155.0k (77 -> 98), but both still fail rule k (17-18k ADA sides, under 120 holders), so no Solada ticket. SHARKY took King of the Hill at 84.1% curve with 65 holders. The Grumpy Walrus added ~7.6k ADA of COCK/ADA liquidity and now holds ~28% of that pool's LP. Pump arm opened Dacity as its strongest L2 ($6.25M, holders 7,220 -> 8,699). New rule aa: zero-holder copycat tickers are farm noise.
